subject: words
title: Ow and oy: cow, boy
about: Two more ways to spell sounds he already knows from CKLA Unit 3: ow says the ou sound (cow, town) and oy says the oi sound (boy, toy). CKLA Grade 1 does not teach these spellings (cow and how are tricky words at school; ow and oy come in Grade 2), so this is a step-ahead level for any time after the Ou and Oi levels; NC RF.1.4.b (regularly spelled one-syllable words).
tip: Say the ouch sound for ow and the coin sound for oy; ask him which of the two teams he can see in the word.
